description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Signs & Portents lasts for one turn.

name: Field Marshal [Death Rage]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Death Rage. (When a model with Death Rage is disabled by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack, then the model is then destroyed. When making this attack, ignore the effects of crippled aspects on the affected warbeast.)

name: Poison
description: Gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against living models.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Cygnar]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Cygnar.

name: Sacred Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

name: Shield Wall
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Khador and Protectorate]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Khador and the Protectorate.

name: Dual Shot
description: If this model/unit uses its Normal Movement to aim, this model can make one additional ranged attack this activation.

name: Marksman
description: When damaging a warjack or warbeast with a ranged attack, choose which column or branch suffers damage.

name: Prowl
description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

name: Deadly Shot
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve an attack with this weapon, you can choose to have a model hit by this weapon suffer 3 damage points instead. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: Knockdown
description: When a model is hit by an attack with this weapon, it becomes knocked down.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Crucible Guard, Cygnar, Retribution, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Crucible Guard, Cygnar, Retribution, and Trollbloods.

name: Animosity [Saxon Orrik]
description: This unit cannot be part of a force that includes Saxon Orrik.

name: Applied Knowledge (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warrior model. If the model is in range, when it damages a warjack or warbeast with an attack, you choose which column or branch suffers the damage. Applied Knowledge lasts for one round.

name: First Aid [d3] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Wind Barrier (★ Action)
description: Non-magical ranged attacks targeting this model or another model in its unit within 2" of it automatically miss. Wind Barrier lasts for one round.

name: •Wind Burst (★ Attack)
description: Wind Burst is a RNG 10, AOE 3, POW 12/7 arcane attack. After resolving this attack, cloud effects in the spellcaster’s control range expire.

name: •Zephyr (★ Action)
description: Each model in this unit can immediately advance up to 3".

name: True Sight
description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

name: •Guidance (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.
